title.en: An Act to Authorize the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office to Hold Annually a Lottery or Sweepstakes for the Expansion of the Philippine National Red Cross Blood Bank
title.orig: An Act to Authorize the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office to Hold Annually a Lottery or Sweepstakes for the Expansion of the Philippine National Red Cross Blood Bank

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_3867_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office is authorized to hold annually a lottery or sweepstakes, the whole proceeds of which shall, after deducting the prizes and expenses as provided for in Republic Act Numbered Eleven hundred sixty-nine, as amended, be turned over to the Philippine National Red Cross Blood Bank for its expansion and for its blood typing project.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 12, 1964.
